blocking.title: On a phone the war banners' names are cut to 0-3 letters (R168's regression): 'J… & 2 ⚔ C… & 1' on every 1938 phone game
blocking.evidence: node critic/scripts/c80_bannerNames.mjs 68901 400 390 844 on HEAD: Soviet Union 7/12, Japan 1/5, Japan 1/5, China 0/5 letters shown (critic/c80_bn_68901_400_390x844_5401.log, critic/shots/c80bn_1938_68901_d400_390x844_5401_row.png); run 79's build on the same case shows the names whole (critic/shots/c80bn_1938_68901_d400_390x844_5402_row.png). Day 0: 'J… & 2 ⚔ C… & 1' (critic/shots/c80bn_1938_68901_d0_390x844_5401_row.png); 68903 day 700: 'T… ⚔ Gr…' (critic/shots/c80bn_1938_68903_d700_390x844_5401.png). Whole at 844x390, 1024x768, 1280x720, 1600x900 and in the opened row. warBannerRows1938's R168 case runs only at 1600x900.
blocking.fix: On a phone keep the name's width (flex-shrink 0 to a minimum of about 4-5 em) and give way with the score or the '& n' first, or fit fewer banners in the closed row. Seen fixed when the probe above and '68903 700 390 844' show each side with at least 5 letters or the whole name, and the 1600x900 random case (SCEN=random 64965 730 1600 900) stays whole.
